usedFor: HeySummit registers summit attendees, and Documint turns each “New Attendee” into a document through “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee” in HeySummit, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: Each registration fills your document template, so every attendee gets paperwork without anyone typing names.

watchOut: “New Attendee” and “Ticket Purchased” both run on registration, so pick one or each person gets two documents.
